auth_settings.title: Authentication
auth_settings.subtitle: Manage the portal's login security options
auth_settings.two_fa_enabled_help: When on, every user must set up an authenticator app (QR code on first login) and enter a code on every login. When off, users sign in with just email and password.
auth_settings.max_attempts_help: After this many consecutive failed attempts, the account is temporarily locked.
auth_settings.lockout_minutes_help: How many minutes the account stays locked after exceeding the max attempts, before automatically unlocking.
auth_settings.notification_email_help: An email will be sent to this address whenever a user is deactivated.
auth_settings.access_token_minutes_help: How long the access token stays valid before it auto-refreshes.
auth_settings.refresh_token_days_help: After this many days of inactivity, the user will need to log in again.

firewall.title: Routes
firewall.subtitle: Manage proxy routes, validation pipelines and logs for the apiserv gateway
firewall.ips_placeholder: One IP or CIDR per line, e.g. 1.2.3.4 or 10.0.0.0/24
firewall.fields_placeholder: One field per line, e.g. name or user.email
firewall.name_path_required: Name and path pattern are required
firewall.invalid_json_schema: The JSON schema is invalid, please fix it before saving
firewall.no_backend_url: No backend_url configured for this app
firewall.log_retention_help: Days to keep firewall logs (0 = forever)
firewall.test_route_headers: Extra headers, one per line (e.g. X-API-Key: mykey)
firewall.function_detail_desc: Function execution output and logs for this request.
firewall.action_pass_help: The request is forwarded directly to the target, skipping the validation pipeline.
firewall.action_pipeline_help: The request first runs the selected validation pipelines (in priority order), then is forwarded to the target.
firewall.action_block_help: The request is rejected immediately with the specified HTTP status code.
firewall.action_ignore_help: The request is dropped: it is not forwarded and the sender receives no response at all.
firewall.action_respond_help: The request is not forwarded: a configured static response is returned directly instead.
firewall.action_function_help: The request is handled by a serverless function: its return value {status_code, headers, body} becomes the response.
firewall.no_functions_hint: No functions available. Create one under Computing → Functions.
firewall.on_fail_help: Run a serverless function when one of the checks fails.
firewall.on_fail_mode_hook_help: The function runs (e.g. log/notify) but the request is still blocked with 403.
firewall.on_fail_mode_override_help: If the function returns a response {status_code, body}, it is returned instead of the 403 block.
firewall.groups_help: Groups help you organize and filter routes and pipelines. You can create, rename or delete them.
firewall.route_form_help: Configure how this request is handled by the firewall.
firewall.pipeline_form_help: Define the security checks to run on a request.
firewall.import_none: No valid routes found in the CSV file
firewall.review_help: Configure this imported route, then save and continue or apply the same settings to all imported routes.
firewall.apply_to_all_confirm_desc: The current settings (action, target, pipeline, group, headers, status) will be applied to all {{count}} imported routes, overwriting any already configured. Each route's name, method, path and description will not be changed.
firewall.path_prefix_help: The prefix is prepended to the path of all routes in this group (and its subgroups). Nested group prefixes are combined.
firewall.map_columns_help: Match the CSV file's columns to the route fields. Fields marked * are required.
firewall.map_field_notes: Notes (appended in parentheses to the description)
firewall.bulk_delete_confirm_desc_one: You are about to permanently delete {{count}} selected item. This cannot be undone.
firewall.bulk_delete_confirm_desc_other: You are about to permanently delete {{count}} selected items. This cannot be undone.

api_keys.title: API Keys
api_keys.subtitle: Create and manage API keys to attach to pipeline X-API-Key checks
api_keys.expiry_help: After this date the key will no longer be valid for X-API-Key checks
api_keys.rotate_confirm_desc: A new value will be generated. The old value will immediately stop being valid for any pipeline using it.
api_keys.bits_help: Sets the strength of the generated key (letters and numbers)
api_keys.generated_help: Generated key: copy it, it will not be recoverable if saved as a hash
api_keys.hash_help: The key will be stored as a BCrypt hash and can no longer be viewed in clear text. Copy it now.
api_keys.new_key_desc: Copy this key now: if saved as a hash it cannot be recovered later.

functions.title: Functions
functions.subtitle: Create isolated serverless functions in Python and JavaScript to attach to routes and pipelines
functions.form_help: Define a handler(event) function that receives the event and returns {status_code, headers, body}.
functions.handler_hint: Define a function named 'handler(event)'. Execution is isolated: network, subprocesses and external filesystem access are blocked.
functions.test_hint: Run the function with a sample event to see its output.
functions.variables_help: Securely injected into event.vars, without writing them in the code
functions.history_help: Previous code versions: select a version and restore it if a change introduced a bug.
functions.no_versions: No previous versions yet. Versions are saved on every code change.
